name: base_utils
description: Provides shared operating-system utilities, including configurable package installation and optional /etc/motd management. It also supplies custom Puppet types, functions, facts, a Bolt task, Hiera data, and a MOTD template.

name: profile_app_stack
description: Coordinates the full Python application stack, including Python runtime setup, database integration, application deployment, systemd service management, monitoring and logging, and environment configuration.

name: profile_haproxy
description: Installs and configures an HAProxy load balancer with backend discovery and health checks, statistics and error pages, firewall rules, optional TLS termination, and managed service lifecycle.

name: profile_postgresql
description: Installs PostgreSQL using distribution-appropriate repository and versioned package configuration, then manages the PostgreSQL service lifecycle.

name: profile_redis_cluster
description: Installs Redis and manages a persistent, password-protected Redis configuration with configurable port, persistence, memory policy, and cluster-node discovery.
